verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on pricing, a free tier, included credits, or self-serve signup. Pricing access is a fair question for a cloud sandbox and agent-hosting platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none. The only cost-related item concerns expiration policies for controlling snapshot storage costs, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales
